The '''Hidden Chain flagship''' was a [[Leviathan-class transport|''Leviathan''-class transport]] [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] used by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] of the [[Hidden Chain]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]. The ship transported the [[Holocron Machine]] created by the Hidden Chain leader [[Heta Kol]] to create an army of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] soldiers. The ship was eventually destroyed when the [[Eternal Alliance]] [[Mission to Hidden Chain Ship|boarded]] the vessel to destroy the machine and recover [[Darth Nul's holocron]].<ref name="TOR:Sundering" />
